verses.1: These are the family lines of Noah's sons — Shem, Ham, and Japheth. They had children after the flood.
verses.2: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.3: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.4: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.5: From these families the peoples of the coastlands spread out into different lands, each with their own language, clan, and nation.
verses.6: The sons of Ham were Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
verses.7: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.8: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became the first great warrior on earth.
verses.9: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. That is why people still say, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD."
verses.10: The first cities of his kingdom were Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.11: From that land he went into Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,
verses.12: and also Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah. That is the great city.
verses.13: Egypt was the father of the Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.14: and also the Pathrusim, the Casluhim, and the Caphtorim. The Philistines came from the Casluhim.
verses.15: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of Heth,
verses.16: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.17: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.18: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the clans of the Canaanites spread out to different places.
verses.19: The land of the Canaanites reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.20: These are the descendants of Ham, listed by their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
verses.21: Children were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth. Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.
verses.22: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.23: The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.24: Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
verses.25: Eber had two sons. One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided. His brother was named Joktan.
verses.26: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.29: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All of these were sons of Joktan.
verses.30: The area where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar in the eastern hill country.
verses.31: These are the descendants of Shem, listed by their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
verses.32: These are the family groups of Noah's sons, listed by their genealogies and nations. From these families all the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
